click_through_hint: Click-through requires an available tray menu and a working recovery shortcut. Use either to restore controls.
click_through_unavailable: Keep widget controls active until the tray and recovery shortcut are available.
clear_readability: Clear uses outlined text. If your desktop makes it difficult to read, restore the protective 82% background.
unsaved_message: Save your changes before closing the dashboard?
condition_in_use: Keep this condition enabled while these rules use it: {items}
import_preview: Import integration “{name}” with {profiles} profiles and {rules} rules?
battery_level_help: Remaining battery charge (%). SOC means State of Charge, not battery health.
input_power_help: Total power received from all sources, in watts (W).
output_power_help: Total power supplied to connected devices, in watts (W).
minimum_discharge_level_help: The charge level (%) at which the station stops discharging. Used as the lower limit for the app's runtime estimate.
maximum_charge_level_help: The charge level (%) at which the station stops charging.
ac_input_help: Power received through the AC input, in watts (W). AC means alternating current.
pv_input_help: Power received from solar panels or a car, in watts (W). PV means photovoltaic; DC means direct current.
ac_output_help: Power supplied through the AC outlets, in watts (W). AC means alternating current.
dc_output_help: Power supplied through the 12 V output, in watts (W). DC means direct current.
usb_power_help: Power supplied through this USB port, in watts (W). USB-C and USB-A are connector types.
anderson_help: Power supplied through this Anderson connector, in watts (W). Each API list entry represents one port.
estimated_runtime_help: Approximate runtime calculated by this app from battery capacity, charge above the minimum level and output power. Requires fresh data, zero input and output above 0 W. Separate from EcoFlow's own time estimate.
capacity_wh_help: Battery energy capacity in watt-hours (Wh). One watt-hour is the energy used by a one-watt load in one hour. This local reference is used to estimate runtime; it is not an API measurement.
rule_input_help: On matches input above 0 W; Off matches zero input. Any ignores input. Incoming power may supply connected devices without charging the battery. This condition does not switch the station's input on or off.
rule_min_help: The rule includes this charge level. Leave unset for no lower bound.
rule_max_help: The rule excludes this charge level, except 100%, which is included. Leave unset for no upper bound.
language_guide_text: Add a UTF-8 strings.json catalog in a Windows locale folder under ecoflow_monitor/i18n. Keep the English keys and translate the values. Missing keys use English. Share the catalog through this project's repository.
unsupported_device: Official API support is not confirmed for this device
profile_technical_details_hint: Add comments about this profile. They appear as a tooltip when choosing it.
credentials_hint: Official developer keys only. Leave both fields blank to keep Windows keys, or fill from 1Password below.
credentials_required: Enter both developer keys, or save your keys first.
onepassword_load_first: Fill the latest keys from 1Password before loading devices.
onepassword_save_hint: Creates a new Login item immediately, with the access key as username and the secret key as password. Save settings afterward to use its references. Canceling settings does not remove the item.
onepassword_setup: Requires the 1Password desktop app and CLI (op on PATH). In 1Password, enable Windows Hello and Settings > Developer > Integrate with 1Password CLI. Copy each field's secret reference (op://…). Quotes are accepted. Only references are saved locally; monitoring reads current keys from 1Password for each API request. 1Password manages Windows Hello approval and its session lifetime.
onepassword_waiting: Waiting for 1Password. Approve access with Windows Hello in 1Password, or cancel.
onepassword_loaded: Latest keys filled. Save settings to use these references for monitoring.
onepassword_created: Item created in 1Password. Save settings to use its references.
onepassword_missing: 1Password CLI was not found. Install it and make op available on PATH.
onepassword_start_error: Could not start 1Password CLI. Check its installation and PATH.
onepassword_timeout: 1Password timed out. Try again or use Windows Credential Manager.
onepassword_access_error: 1Password could not provide access. It may have been declined, or the item or app may be unavailable. Check the references, Windows Hello, and CLI integration in 1Password.
onepassword_reference_error: Enter a field reference such as op://Personal/EcoFlow/password. Check quotes and all path components.
onepassword_value_error: The 1Password field must contain a nonempty UTF-8 API key without control characters.
onepassword_save_required: Enter both developer keys, a vault, and an item title first.
onepassword_save_result_error: 1Password did not return usable item references.
onepassword_check_created: The item may already have been created. Check your vault before trying again.
load_devices_hint: Choose your DELTA 3 Max. Other models are not supported by this version.
capacity_hint: 2048 Wh is the model's nominal capacity. The runtime estimate is approximate.
manual_limit_hint: Used only when the API value is missing. These values do not change the station.
main_transparency_hint: 0% hides the background; 100% is solid. Text and icons remain opaque. Preview is temporary until saved.
integration_setup_help: Connect an application: choose it below, select its program, then set up profiles and automatic rules. Use Restore MSI example for a ready-made starting point.
integration_general_help: Name this integration and choose the application it controls. Enable it when you are ready to use its profiles.
integration_profile_help: A profile is a named preset, such as Power saving. Choose what runs when you select it and, optionally, when you switch away. Rules select profiles automatically.
integration_empty_help: No integrations yet. Add one, import a shared configuration, or restore the MSI Afterburner example to get started.
integration_id_help: Technical identifier used by saved rules and commands. The display name above is what you see in the monitor.
mini_above_taskbar: Allow mini widget above the taskbar
mini_metrics: Choose when each metric appears. Drag to reorder within the always-visible and expandable groups.
msi_access_denied: Afterburner data is inaccessible. Check matching permission levels.
msi_error: Afterburner data could not be read.
integration_permission_denied: Windows denied command access. Check executable permissions or start the elevated helper from the tray menu.
integration_elevation_required: Windows requires administrator rights for this command. Start the elevated helper from the tray menu; EcoFlow Monitor can keep running normally.
integration_helper_prompt: Start a separate administrator helper for {name}? Windows will ask for permission. It can execute this integration's configured commands until you disable or edit the integration or exit EcoFlow Monitor. The main application keeps its current access level. Only approve integrations and executables you trust.
integration_helper_ready: Administrator helper connected. You can retry the profile command.
integration_helper_failed: Administrator helper was cancelled, disconnected or could not start. Retry from the tray menu.
profile_description_hint: Descriptions only. Edit and save actual GPU settings in MSI Afterburner.
profile_failed: The profile request failed. Check Afterburner.
profile_expected: Expected power: {power}%. Source: {source}. A request does not confirm the applied profile.
rule_hint: App rules take priority over system rules. Charge ranges include the lower bound and exclude the upper bound, except 100%. With no matching rule, the profile stays unchanged.
invalid_executable: Choose an existing local .exe or a shortcut to one.
invalid_hotkey: Invalid shortcut. Use a combination such as ctrl+alt+num5.
hotkey_conflict: Two enabled actions use the same shortcut.
hotkey_failed: Some shortcuts could not be registered: {actions}
hotkey_hint: Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win, letters, F1–F24, digits and NumPad 0–9.
toggle_monitor: Show or hide the main window
settings_load_error: Settings could not be loaded. The original file is preserved; Save creates a backup before replacing it.
settings_recovery: Automatic saves are paused. Review and save Settings to recover.
settings_save_error: Settings could not be saved. Check directory permissions.
invalid_settings: Check the limits, rules, shortcuts and selected mini metrics.
instance_activation_failed: EcoFlow Monitor is already running, but its window could not be shown. Try again in a few seconds.
instance_start_failed: EcoFlow Monitor could not check whether it is already running. The application will close to prevent a duplicate instance.
no_profile_policy: Auto is enabled; no matching rule.
operation_failed: The operation could not be completed.
integration_reaction_hint: One command template per line. Deactivation runs only when switching profiles. Exit and disabling leave the external state unchanged.
integration_allow_launch: Allow commands to start the application
integration_conditions_hint: Available automation conditions. Remove rules using a condition before disabling it.
integration_mapping_hint: Each command has a stable ID, display label and Windows CLI arguments. Use quotes for arguments containing spaces.
integration_in_use: This item is referenced by a profile or rule. Remove those references first.
integration_duplicate: An integration with this ID already exists.
integration_access_denied: The running executable could not be verified. Check access permissions and privilege levels.
integration_select_executable: Multiple running instances were found. Choose the intended executable in Settings.
integration_cancelled: Settings changed or application is shutting down
integration_failure: {phase}, step {step}: {error}. Completed commands: {completed}. External state may be partial.
outputs_read_only: Power readings only. Station outputs cannot be changed here.
connection_description: Actual secrets are never shown in messages or previews.
language_guide_summary: Choose an available language, or help add a translation. Instructions for translators are available below.
